tasks.subject: Task 1: Id-based deploy methods on Cloud
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `upsert_in`/`replace_in`/`create_if_missing_in` to `Cloud` (operate on a resolved folder id, no `ensure_folder`); refactor the path-based methods into thin wrappers.

**Files:**
- Modify: apps/rmapps/src/cloud.rs (methods ~167-209; tests in mod tests)

**Verify:** cargo test -p rmapps cloud::

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/rmapps/src/cloud.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p rmapps cloud::", "acceptanceCriteria": ["three *_in methods exist", "path methods delegate via ensure_folder", "existing replace tests pass", "replace_in test passes"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Fake-cloud staleness seam + bug-lock test
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `FakeCloud::lag_next_commit(n)` so a commit's effect is invisible to the next n root reads (poisoning the store); bug-lock test proves two `mkdir_p` of one path mint a duplicate under lag.

**Files:**
- Modify: crates/rm-cloud/src/fake/mod.rs (State lag fields + helper)
- Modify: crates/rm-cloud/src/fake/handlers.rs (root_put arms; root_get serves stale)
- Modify: crates/rm-cloud/src/porcelain/fs.rs (fs_tests bug-lock)

**Verify:** cargo test -p rm-cloud --features fake fs_tests::lagging_index

```json:metadata
{"files": ["crates/rm-cloud/src/fake/mod.rs", "crates/rm-cloud/src/fake/handlers.rs", "crates/rm-cloud/src/porcelain/fs.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p rm-cloud --features fake", "acceptanceCriteria": ["lag_next_commit arms next commit", "stale GETs serve pre-commit hash at current generation", "two mkdir_p under lag return different ids"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: FolderIds run-scoped resolver + fix tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Add `FolderIds` (path->id memo, resolve once per run); fix test proves two docs to /Readwise under lag yield exactly one folder; bujo-shaped guard test.

**Files:**
- Modify: apps/rmapps/src/cloud.rs (FolderIds + tests)

**Verify:** cargo test -p rmapps cloud::

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/rmapps/src/cloud.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test -p rmapps cloud::", "acceptanceCriteria": ["FolderIds::new + get memo, pub", "repeated get returns same id, one ensure_folder", "resolver yields one folder under lag", "14-doc single-target guard passes"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Wire reader and bujo to the resolver
tasks.description:
**Goal:** reader upload loop and bujo deploy loops resolve each distinct path once via FolderIds and call the *_in methods.

**Files:**
- Modify: apps/rmapps/src/reader.rs (upload loop ~74-79)
- Modify: apps/rmapps/src/bujo.rs (deploy loops ~146-153 and ~159-166)

**Verify:** cargo test --workspace

```json:metadata
{"files": ["apps/rmapps/src/reader.rs", "apps/rmapps/src/bujo.rs"], "verifyCommand": "cargo test --workspace", "acceptanceCriteria": ["reader uses FolderIds + replace_in", "bujo loops use FolderIds + upsert_in/create_if_missing_in", "workspace tests green", "clean build"], "requiresUserVerification": false}
```
